The Blue Kite Announces Opening for Social Media Associate Role in Goa via LinkedIn

04 Nov 2026, 02:21 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: in.linkedin.com

Overview of the Reported Role

According to a professional platform listing reported on LinkedIn, hospitality and lifestyle organization The Blue Kite has advertised an opening for a Social Media Associate based in Mapusa, Goa, India. The published notice details responsibilities centered on digital marketing execution, content planning, and influencer campaign management.

Reported Responsibilities and Requirements

Based on the source text retrieved from the platform listing, the reported duties and expectations for candidates include:

  • Content Management: Maintaining monthly social content calendars, managing daily posting schedules, and publishing stories and reels across platforms like Instagram.
  • Influencer Marketing: Leading outreach, onboarding, campaign coordination, gifting logistics, and ongoing communications with creators.
  • Campaign Execution: Assisting with broader marketing activations and ensuring alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Professional Background: Requiring 1 to 2 years of experience in digital marketing, social media, or content creation, alongside familiarity with tools such as Canva and platforms including LinkedIn and Instagram.

Practical Implications and Verification

Job seekers interested in verifying the original announcement or reviewing updated application statuses can access the listing directly through professional networking services like LinkedIn under the official posting from The Blue Kite. Applicants should independently review current eligibility criteria, role availability, and submission deadlines directly on the hosting platform, as employment listings are subject to change without prior notice.
